summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate) by reading and editing files only; no tests or repository code were run and nothing was committed. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update container (prologue, algebra) beside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate builds the prologue from the first declaration group before the empty-request exit and always returns an Update container; the non-empty path re-applies group 0 once more, which is idempotent but redundant. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring states it takes an Update container. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate beside prepareQuery; SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update is unchanged because it already passes non-strings through. (5) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. (6) test/test_sparql_prepare.py is a new test module covering prepare-then-apply, reuse, initNs prefixes, direct evaluation, container shape, empty and declarations-only requests, empty strings, and the no-mutation check. Not covered by a test: the initial-bindings acceptance criterion. pprintAlgebra in the DAWG failure-debug path still receives the container, unchanged. Verification is by reading only; the tests and the DAWG suite have not been run.
